title: Full Stack Developer – Next.js & NestJS | ERP / SaaS
description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for a highly skilled, intelligent, and technically strong **Full Stack Developer** with hands-on experience in Next.js, NestJS, and modern web application development.

The ideal candidate should have experience developing complex ERP, CRM, SaaS, or enterprise-level applications and should be comfortable handling both frontend and backend development.

We are particularly interested in developers who are highly proficient in using AI-powered coding tools to accelerate development, improve code quality, debug complex issues, and build production-ready applications.

This is an opportunity to work on challenging, large-scale software products involving business automation, enterprise workflows, financial integrations, APIs, and mobile application backends.

We need a developer who can think independently, understand architecture, solve problems, and take complete ownership of development tasks.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable web applications using Next.js and NestJS.
* Build modern, responsive, high-performance frontend applications.
* Develop robust backend services, REST APIs, and business logic.
* Design scalable database structures, relationships, indexes, and optimized SQL queries.
* Develop complex ERP/CRM modules, business workflows, role-based access systems, and multi-tenant architectures.
* Build and maintain API integrations with third-party platforms, payment gateways, and external services.
* Develop backend services and APIs that support Android and iOS mobile applications.
* Implement authentication, authorization, security mechanisms, and data validation.
* Optimize application performance, database queries, API response times, and server resources.
* Work with AI coding assistants to accelerate development, debugging, code reviews, refactoring, and testing.
* Write clean, reusable, modular, maintainable, and well-documented code.
* Identify and resolve technical issues independently.
* Collaborate with UI/UX designers, testers, project managers, and other developers.
* Participate in code reviews, architecture discussions, deployment, and production support.

**Mandatory Technical Skills**

**Frontend Development**

* Strong hands-on experience with Next.js and React.js.
* Excellent knowledge of JavaScript and TypeScript.
* Experience with modern frontend architecture, reusable components, hooks, and state management.
* Strong HTML5, CSS3, responsive design, and UI integration skills.
* Experience with Tailwind CSS or similar styling frameworks.
* Understanding of frontend performance optimization and SEO fundamentals.

**Backend Development**

* Strong hands-on experience with NestJS and Node.js.
* Excellent understanding of TypeScript and backend application architecture.
* Experience developing RESTful APIs and integrating third-party APIs.
* Knowledge of authentication, JWT, OAuth2, RBAC, guards, middleware, and API security.
* Experience with background jobs, queues, scheduled tasks, event-driven architecture, and caching.
* Understanding of microservices architecture and scalable backend design.

**Database & Architecture**

* Strong experience with PostgreSQL and/or MySQL.
* Excellent understanding of relational database design, normalization, indexing, joins, transactions, and query optimization.
* Experience designing complex database schemas for ERP/CRM applications.
* Understanding of multi-tenant SaaS architecture.
* Experience with Redis, caching, and database performance optimization.
* Ability to understand and maintain large existing codebases.

**AI-Assisted Development – Very Important**

We are looking for a developer who can effectively use modern AI development tools as part of their everyday engineering workflow.

Experience with tools such as:

* Claude Code
* Cursor
* GitHub Copilot
* OpenAI Codex
* Other AI-powered development agents.

The candidate should know how to:

* Use AI agents to understand and navigate large codebases.
* Generate, refactor, and optimize production-quality code.
* Use AI for debugging, root-cause analysis, and resolving complex issues.
* Develop features using structured prompts and well-defined technical instructions.
* Review AI-generated code and identify incorrect logic, security vulnerabilities, and performance issues.
* Use AI for automated testing, documentation, and code quality improvements.
* Manage AI-assisted development without compromising architecture, security, or maintainability.

**Important:** We need someone who understands programming fundamentals deeply and uses AI as a powerful engineering tool, not someone who blindly copies AI-generated code.

**ERP / CRM / SaaS Experience**

Candidates with experience developing or maintaining complex ERP, CRM, or enterprise SaaS applications will be given high priority.

You should understand:

* Multi-module business applications.
* Complex business workflows and interconnected modules.
* Role-based permissions and access control.
* Multi-company and multi-tenant systems.
* Financial transactions, billing, subscriptions, and payment workflows.
* Dynamic forms, configurable fields, reports, dashboards, and data management.
* Large relational databases and data consistency.
* Third-party API integrations and automation.

**Mobile Application Backend Experience**

Experience supporting mobile applications is highly desirable.

* Building APIs for Android and iOS applications.
* Mobile authentication and secure API communication.
* Push notifications and real-time communication.
* File uploads, media management, and cloud storage.
* Background processing and synchronization.
* API versioning and mobile application compatibility.

**How to Apply**

Please submit your CV along with your **GitHub/portfolio**, if available.

When applying, mention the **most complex backend, SaaS, ERP/CRM or AI-integrated project** you have worked on and your specific contribution to it.

Job Types: Full-time, Permanent

Pay: ₹30,000.00 - ₹60,000.00 per month

Experience:

* Backend Developer: 3 years (Required)
